items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Virgis and I used to write the melodies. ... Joe and I, we wrote quite a few numbers together.

ctx.x: Words or music, Sam? Do you remember?
Sam, words. He wrote all the lyrics of words. He didn't play the piano or anything like that. He didn't write the melodies at all. Virgis and I used to write the melodies.
